title: Currency Note Press Recruitment 2026 - 534 Posts, ITI/Diploma Eligible, Apply by May 19
author: Ash K.
summary: Currency Note Press Nashik (SPMCIL) recruitment for 534 Supervisor, Junior Technician, and other posts across 4 security presses. Apply online by May 19, 2026. ITI, Diploma, and Degree holders eligible. Salary up to ₹67,390. No negative marking in exam.
body: Currency Note Press (CNP), Nashik, under Security Printing & Minting Corporation of India Limited (SPMCIL), has released recruitment notification for 534 posts across 4 currency/security presses. Last date to apply is May 19, 2026 - 3 days left.

DetailInformation
Total Posts534
OrganizationSPMCIL (Mini-Ratna Category-I PSU)
PostsJunior Technician, Supervisor, JOA, Welfare Officer, Safety Officer, Artist
Apply StartApril 20, 2026
Last DateMay 19, 2026
Eligibility10th + ITI / Diploma / Degree (post-wise)
Age Limit18-25/28/30 years (post-wise)
Salary Range₹19,000 – ₹67,390/month
Application Fee₹1,000 (Gen/OBC/EWS), ₹200 (SC/ST/PwBD)
SelectionOnline Exam + Skill/Trade Test + DV + Medical
Negative MarkingNo
Posting LocationsNashik, Dewas (MP), Hyderabad

4 presses hiring: Currency Note Press Nashik (CNPN), India Security Press Nashik (ISPN), Bank Note Press Dewas (BNPD), and Security Printing Press Hyderabad (SPPH). These are the presses that print Indian currency notes, stamps, passports, and other security documents.

Major posts and eligibility: Junior Technician (W-1 Level): 10th + ITI in relevant trade. Supervisor (W-5/W-6 Level): Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in relevant engineering discipline. Junior Office Assistant: Graduate with typing speed 30 WPM. Welfare Officer: MSW/MBA(HR)/PG in Sociology. Safety Officer: B.E./B.Tech + Diploma in Industrial Safety.

Selection process: Online examination (objective type, no negative marking) followed by Skill/Trade Test for technical posts, Document Verification, and Medical Examination. The online exam covers General Intelligence, English/Hindi, Quantitative Aptitude, and trade-specific knowledge.
How to apply: Visit cnpnashik.spmcil.com → Click on 'Online Recruitment' → Register → Fill application form → Upload documents → Pay fee → Submit. Ensure all details are correct before submission.

SPMCIL jobs offer central government benefits including DA, HRA, medical coverage, and pension. For similar technical government jobs, check our SSC CGL guide and age relaxation rules for government jobs.

faqs.question: When is the last date to apply for Currency Note Press 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the online application is May 19, 2026 at cnpnashik.spmcil.com.

faqs.answer: 10th pass with ITI certificate in the relevant trade (Electrician, Fitter, Machinist, etc.).

faqs.answer: No. There is no negative marking in the online examination. Attempt all questions.

faqs.answer: Junior Technician posts start at W-1 level with salary approximately ₹19,000-24,000/month. Senior posts like Supervisor get up to ₹67,390/month.

faqs.answer: Posts are across 4 SPMCIL units: Currency Note Press Nashik, India Security Press Nashik, Bank Note Press Dewas (MP), and Security Printing Press Hyderabad.
